parameters.content:
## The monthly update run

This is the background job. `65 - TOOL - start_monthly_update` fires it and
does not wait; `66 - TOOL - get_monthly_update` reads the result later.

The order matters. Nothing expensive happens until the cheap filters have
done their work: a month of mail is listed, scored against your company
profile with no model involved at all, and only what survives is read.

Gmail access is read-only. This cannot send, reply, label, or delete.

## What a run costs

About $1.50 to $2.50 for an ordinary month. The two dials that move it are
`maxCandidates` and `maxThreads` in the **Plan Run** node.

Every run records its own token counts, so after two months you can read
your real number instead of trusting that estimate.

parameters.jsCode:
const state = $input.first().json ?? {};
const plan = $('Plan Run').first().json;

const MESSAGES = {
  no_profile: 'I do not have a company profile saved yet, so I did not read any email. Tell me what the company is called and its email domain, and anything you know about your customers, investors, and product names, and I will save it.',
  bad_month: 'I could not read that month. Ask me again with a month like "July" or "2026-07".',
  future_month: 'That month has not happened yet.',
  gmail_error: 'I could not read your mail this time. The read-only Gmail connection in n8n may need reconnecting.',
  no_messages: `There was no mail at all in ${plan.monthLabel} once spam, promotions, and social were excluded.`,
  no_candidates: `Nothing in ${plan.monthLabel} looked like company news. That usually means the profile is thin — if I do not know your customers, investors, or product names, I cannot tell their mail apart from everything else.`,
  nothing_worth_reporting: `I read through ${plan.monthLabel} and nothing in it rose to the level of a monthly update. That is a real answer, not a failure.`,
  classification_failed: 'I read your mail but could not assess any of it, so there is nothing to report. Running it again is safe.',
  no_evidence: `I read the most promising threads from ${plan.monthLabel} but none of them contained a fact solid enough to report.`,
};

const stopReason = String(state.stopReason ?? 'unknown');
const status = String(state.status ?? 'failed');

return [{ json: {
  runId: plan.runId ?? state.runId ?? '',
  startedAt: plan.startedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
  finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  status,
  monthLabel: plan.monthLabel ?? '',
  monthBucket: plan.monthBucket ?? '',
  windowStart: plan.windowStart ?? '',
  windowEnd: plan.windowEnd ?? '',
  audience: plan.audience ?? '',
  messagesListed: Number(state.messagesListed ?? 0),
  messagesAfterHeuristic: Number(state.messagesAfterHeuristic ?? 0),
  messagesClassified: Number(state.messagesClassified ?? 0),
  threadsExtracted: Number(state.threadsExtracted ?? 0),
  evidenceExtracted: Number(state.evidenceExtracted ?? 0),
  evidenceIncluded: 0,
  inputTokens: Number(state.inputTokens ?? state.classifyInputTokens ?? 0),
  outputTokens: Number(state.outputTokens ?? state.classifyOutputTokens ?? 0),
  groundednessStatus: 'not_applicable',
  groundednessNotes: '',
  updateText: MESSAGES[stopReason] ?? 'The monthly update did not produce anything this time.',
  structuredJson: '{}',
  errorSummary: String(state.errorSummary ?? ''),
  evidence: [],
  deliverToSlack: false,
  slackChannel: '',
} }];

const run = $('Save Run').first().json;
const source = $('Render Update').first().json;
const records = source.curated ?? [];

return records.map((record, position) => ({ json: {
  evidenceId: `${source.runId}-${position}`,
  runId: source.runId,
  monthBucket: source.monthBucket,
  kind: String(record.kind ?? ''),
  canonicalKey: String(record.canonicalKey ?? ''),
  eventType: String(record.eventType ?? ''),
  metricKey: String(record.metricKey ?? ''),
  valueText: String(record.valueText ?? ''),
  valueNumber: String(record.valueNumber ?? ''),
  unit: String(record.unit ?? ''),
  title: String(record.kind === 'event' ? (record.title ?? '') : (record.metricName ?? '')),
  summary: String(record.summary ?? ''),
  eventDate: String(record.eventDate ?? ''),
  datePrecision: String(record.datePrecision ?? ''),
  sentiment: String(record.sentiment ?? ''),
  importance: Number(record.importance ?? 0),
  confidence: Number(record.confidence ?? 0),
  evidenceMessageIds: (record.evidenceMessageIds ?? []).join(','),
  sourceThreadIds: (record.sourceThreadIds ?? []).join(','),
  includeDecision: String(record.includeDecision ?? ''),
  includeScore: Number(record.includeScore ?? 0),
  suggestedSection: String(record.suggestedSection ?? ''),
  whyItMatters: String(record.whyItMatters ?? ''),
  excludeReason: String(record.excludeReason ?? ''),
  needsReview: record.needsReview ? 'yes' : 'no',
} }));
